main_body: A wooden cart bed with three grey buckets of flowers standing on it, and wheels/legs below. The bed is the largest volume.
top_band: none. At x=15 the column runs from the plants (rows 2-4) to the grey buckets, then a dark row 10-11 (L=29), a 1-row edge line at row 12 (L=98), and the brown front face at rows 13-19 (L=64). No lighter horizontal surface is visible on the bed.
evidence: The bed reads as a flat brown front panel. Its top is hidden under the buckets and is marked only by a 1-row highlight at row 12, which is a rim and not a surface. There is no cart-bed surface band like the reference cart. The small lighter brown patches at the far left and right ends are tiny and do not make a top for the main body. The top is effectively a 0-1px line over a front face, so this is a front elevation.

style.evidence: The candidate carries 33 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, and its flat-fill coverage is 6%, below the stall's 13%. Only 22% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are mostly tinted: dark brown beside wood and dark green beside leaves. The foliage, flowers and grey buckets are shaded in several steps. The brown cart body is somewhat flat, but it still holds up beside the references.
